description: This file implements the RDKWindowManager class, which manages window-related functionalities within the RDK framework. It includes initialization, deinitialization, and notification handling for the window manager component, and registers the service with the framework.

classes.name: RDKWindowManager
classes.description: Main class managing the RDK window system, handling initialization, deinitialization, notifications, and service registration within the framework.

methods.name: RDKWindowManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the RDKWindowManager instance, setting up internal state and registering the service.

methods.name: ~RDKWindowManager
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up resources and unregistering the service.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the window manager with the provided service, setting up necessary components and registering for notifications.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters notifications, and deinitializes the service.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns a JSON string with service information.
